changelog: Vortex v5.5.28: live match rosters stop showing every player as "Hidden" - Riot flags almost everyone Incognito during agent select and the loading screen, so Vortex now trusts the name service and only marks a player hidden once it has genuinely given up resolving them ("Resolving..." until then). Hidden players are still clickable for their session rank and combat. Also: automatic local database backups with portable export/import, live telemetry (Overwolf and the Valorant Tracker fallback) is now a pair of default-off switches in Settings, and the settings-preset/copy-config feature has been removed.
